newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bidding for inastallation of three barge-mounted power plants, the first such initiative for power generation in the private sector, will be held on January 15.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is likely to visit New Delhi on December 9 or 10 to sign with India a Ganges water sharing treaty already drafted.
Negotiations are continuing with the Shanti Bahini to secure the release of six non-tribesmen, including two officials, kidnapped and held hostage by the Chakma insurgents since November 29.
The High Court division of the Supreme Court yesterday issued a rule upon the government after accepting two writ petitions that were filed challenging the validity of the Indemnity Repeal Act, 1996.
The Power Development Board, reeling under generation shortfall, Monday held a meeting with a host of leading international companies who submitted bids for three barge-mounted power plants.
Former finance minister M. Saifur Rahman sniped at the government's "policy reversal" in respect of some recent economic and monetary measures which, he said, could prove counter-productive.
